answer: Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the lagoon queue while genuine members promoted earlier still earns. The mesa index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1089 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the river. A 419 account operation therefore ties up 16 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
